plan.title: Save as draft is not offered when vendor addition is unlocked

steps.note: Open the Events screen to reach the existing draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the draft flow.
Set the condition under test so vendor addition is not locked during event creation.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the case.
Confirm the events list rendered before selecting its Drafts tab.
Open the draft event, which returns to its create screen.
Assert that Save as draft is not offered under the requested setting.
